metadata.source: NIST XCOM Version 3.1, local Fortran source/data
metadata.sampling: adaptive log-log with explicit below/above absorption-edge pairs
metadata.validation: native quarter/midpoint probes plus 200 independent seeded holdouts per material and both sides of each edge
metadata.precision_note: Interpolation tolerance and storage precision do not represent physical cross-section accuracy.

glass_sio2.note: glass surrogate assumed as SiO2; identical numbers to sio2
